name: dotfiles
description: Repo-root graduation project (writing-bun-scripts BG3). Exists so repo .ts scripts may import pinned deps by bare specifier; the pin lives here and in bun.lock, never in the import string. Bun resolves through the ~/.claude/skills symlinks to this realpath, so linked scripts resolve from any cwd. Hooks stay zero-dep: they run before any install.
